skill1: Combat Assist: Changes to Burst Stage 1. This effect is continuous.
burst: Skill 2's requirement for triggering attachable projectiles ▼ 60 for 10 sec.

caveats: ⚑ The 150.72% Projectile Attachment / 100.6% Projectile Explosion continuous buffs are authored as generic attackDamagePct because the schema has no flavor-scoped stat key. This OVER-CREDITS every non-projectile hit (all normal MG fire + the 2808% nuke) by ~251pp of Damage Up and is almost certainly WRONG in magnitude distribution — it needs a flavor-scoped stat (projectileAttachmentDamagePct / projectileExplosionDamagePct) or the buffs must be folded into the projectile effects' own atkPct. Same defect applies to the burst's 421.2% Projectile Attachment line.
⚑ The 120-normal-attack counter: MG hitsPerShot is 1, so 120 rounds ≈ one 300-ammo magazine's first 40%. Whether the counter counts ROUNDS or trigger PULLS is kit-silent; assumed rounds.
⚑ Split-vs-merge for the attachable projectile is kit-silent: modeled as ONE attachment hit + ONE stored explosion charge (Max Ammunition Capacity 1 round supports a single projectile in flight).
⚑ The stage-3 burst's Skill-2 threshold reduction (120→60 for 10s) is NOT modeled — the engine has no dynamic-trigger-count primitive. This UNDER-credits projectile procs during the burst window.
⚑ Explosion core rate 0.33 and crit:true on both projectile components are priors-sourced estimates, not derived from this kit text.
override.note: PARSER BASELINE (HYPOTHESIS — NOT a validated model). Every ⚑ below is an UNMEASURED estimate; hand-tune + record against a real fight before trusting any number. Structure: S1 is a formation-gated pair — with NO Burst-1 ally the unit holds Combat Assist (acts as B1) and its FB-enter branch buffs ALL allies (CDR 7.48s + Attack Damage 8.02%); with a Burst-1 ally present Combat Assist is cancelled and the FB-enter branch instead self-buffs ATK 95.04% + Interruption-Part damage 48%. Modeled with formation:'noB1' / 'hasB1' respectively. S2 grants Electric elemental advantage (advantageVs) plus two continuous projectile-flavor Damage-Up buffs and a 120-normal-attack attachable projectile whose explosion is held until Full Burst (storedHit). Burst is stage-split via burstCast stage 1 (self CDR 20s + ally caster-scaled ATK 18.01%) vs stage 3 (2808% nuke + Projectile Attachment 421.2%). Combat Assist's stage-change itself is unmodeled: the engine has no runtime burst-stage reassignment, so the noB1 case is expressed only through the formation gate, NOT by actually casting the unit at stage 1 — this is the single largest structural approximation here and it makes the stage-1 burst branch effectively unreachable in a normal B1+B2+B3 comp.

flags.reasoning: The kit scopes these to Projectile Attachment Damage and Projectile Explosion Damage specifically. The StatKey enum has projectile FLAVORS on flatDamage/dot/storedHit but no matching flavor-scoped stat key, so a faithful encoding is impossible in the current schema. Generic attackDamagePct over-credits ~251pp of Damage Up onto all 300 rounds of MG fire and onto the 2808% nuke — a very large error in the wrong direction. Failure-mode taxonomy #1 (SCOPE) exactly.
flags.recipe: Either (a) add projectileAttachmentDamagePct / projectileExplosionDamagePct StatKeys that only feed hits carrying the matching flavor, or (b) fold the multipliers into the projectile effects' own atkPct (88.11 x (1+1.5072) attachment, 88.11 x (1+1.006) explosion) and drop the buffs — (b) is exact only while no OTHER source touches those buckets. Verify by reading projectile-explosion popup values against normal-fire popup values in a recording: if normals are unbuffed the generic encoding is refuted.

flags.reasoning: Kit says '120 normal attack(s)' without specifying rounds vs pulls. Base stats give hitsPerShot 1, so for THIS unit the two coincide and the ambiguity is currently harmless — but the encoding choice matters if hitsPerShot is ever corrected.
flags.recipe: Count popups between two consecutive attachment procs in footage; with ammo 300 the first proc should land ~40% into the opening magazine.

flags.estimate: 0.33 core rate on the explosion release
flags.reasoning: Kit text gives NO core information for the explosion. The storedHit schema's own documentation cites an aim-independent explosion core rate near 1/3 as a measured prior for attached-rocket-style explosions, which is the closest available anchor — but applying another unit's measurement to this one is a prior, not a derivation.
flags.recipe: Count red 'CORE HIT' popups vs total explosion popups across a full FB window; the ratio is the rate directly.

flags.estimate: crit: true on attachment, explosion, and the 2808% nuke
flags.reasoning: Stored-hit releases default to crit-OFF in the engine and flatDamage riders are crit-opt-in. The kit says nothing either way. Set true on the general principle that function damage crits at the caster's sheet rate unless measured otherwise.
flags.recipe: Look for orange/crit-iconed popup bodies on explosion and nuke hits in a recording; a clean 0% crit rate over many samples refutes.

flags.estimate: ONE attachment hit + ONE explosion charge per 120-attack proc
flags.reasoning: 'Attachable projectiles' is plural in the kit text but 'Max Ammunition Capacity: 1 round(s)' bounds the projectile magazine to a single round, so one projectile per proc is the reading consistent with both lines. Split-vs-merge is an ALWAYS-flag field regardless.
flags.recipe: Count distinct attachment popups per proc in footage; N popups per proc means charges:N with atkPct divided accordingly.

flags.estimate: Stage-1 blocks authored but effectively dead
flags.reasoning: Combat Assist's 'Changes to Burst Stage 1' is unmodeled (no runtime stage reassignment), so in any comp the unit casts at stage 3 and the stage-1 burstCast blocks never fire. The formation:'noB1' S1 branch DOES fire correctly, so the two halves of the noB1 configuration are inconsistently modeled — S1 behaves as if Combat Assist is active while the burst behaves as if it is not.
flags.recipe: Requires an engine feature (per-unit stage override driven by a formation gate). Until then, only grade this unit in comps that HAVE a Burst-1 ally, where the hasB1 branch is the correct one and the inconsistency is inert.

flags.estimate: Not modeled; under-credits projectile procs by up to 1 extra proc per burst window
flags.reasoning: No primitive mutates another block's hitCount threshold for a window. At MG cadence, 60 rounds inside a 10s window is plausibly reachable, so the omission is not negligible.
flags.recipe: Either add a resource/threshold-override primitive, or approximate with a second hitCount block gated to the burst window once the engine supports a threshold override. Measure by counting attachment popups inside vs outside the burst window.

flags.reasoning: Mandatory flag — rate_of_fire and reloadFrames are known-unreliable datamine fields, and the nominal rate is not frame-quantized. For an MG with 300 ammo, cadence directly sets how many 120-round thresholds are crossed per fight, so an error here scales the whole projectile channel.
flags.recipe: Read the ammo counter across a magazine in footage to get rounds/sec directly (the instrument that measures the disputed quantity), then apply 60/ceil(60/nominal) frame quantization.

flags.reasoning: Per the priors, burst-cast/instant damage is FB-exempt because the cast resolves before the Full-Burst window opens. This follows the stated rule rather than a measurement of this unit.
flags.recipe: Compare the nuke popup value against the same unit's buff state with and without the +50% FB major applied; a 1.5x ratio refutes the exemption.
